properties.displayName: QC - D - PowerShell or Python execution via AppleScript
properties.description:
Adversaries use Python based C2 frameworks such as Empire that can execute PowerShell commands etc. on a MacOS device depending on the installation. This detection aims to detect usage of Empire payloads that utilize AppleScript binary that runs Python commands/PowerShell commands. Base64 encoded commands can also be executed via AppleScript on MacOS devices. This query aims to detect the same. 
References:
- https://medium.com /purple-team/creating-malicious-payloads-for-mac-osx-using-empire-tool-f9024432e2dc
- https://github.com/EmpireProject/Empire
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp >= ago(1h)
| where not (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("installer", "Snap Camera"))
| where not (InitiatingProcessFileName contains "PanGpHip" or InitiatingProcessParentFileName contains "PanGpHip" or InitiatingProcessCommandLine contains "GlobalProtect")
| where (ProcessCommandLine has "osascript -e" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shell script", "echo", "import sys", "base64")) 
or (InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "osascript -e" and InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_all ("shell script", "echo", "import sys", "base64"))
